member.name: T:SharpAI.Server.Classes.Runtime.AuthenticationService
member.summary: Establishes the authenticated for each request and attaches it to the HTTP context metadata. Invoked from the Watson PreRouting hook (which fires for every request, unlike the AuthenticateRequest/AuthenticateApiRequest hooks, which Watson only invokes for routes registered with requiresAuthentication: true). When authentication is disabled this installs the system principal; when enabled it resolves the request against the account store (admin API key, bearer session token, or access-key / secret-key). The 401 challenge and RBAC authorization are enforced per-route by the Authorize helper reading the attached context; unauthenticated requests to non-anonymous endpoints are recorded to the security audit log here.

member.name: M:SharpAI.Server.Classes.Runtime.AuthenticationService.#ctor(SharpAI.Server.Classes.Settings.AuthSettings,SharpAI.Security.AuthenticationEngine,SharpAI.Database.DatabaseDriverBase,SyslogLogging.LoggingModule)
member.summary: Instantiate.

member.name: M:SharpAI.Server.Classes.Runtime.AuthenticationService.AttachContext(WatsonWebserver.Core.HttpContextBase)
member.summary: Resolve the request's and attach it to ctx.Metadata so the per-route Authorize helper can enforce authentication (401) and authorization (403). Invoked from the PreRouting hook, which — unlike the authentication hooks — fires for every request regardless of per-route configuration. When the resolved context indicates the request is unauthenticated against a non-anonymous path, the denial is recorded to the audit log here (the actual 401 is thrown by the guarded route).

member.name: T:SharpAI.Server.Classes.Settings.TelemetrySettings
member.summary: Telemetry settings controlling in-process OpenTelemetry export (metrics, traces, and optionally logs) via Radiant, plus an optional in-process Prometheus scrape endpoint. All fields can be overridden by SHARPAI_TELEMETRY_* environment variables at startup. Telemetry is a clean no-op when is false or when no collector is reachable.

member.name: P:SharpAI.Server.Classes.Settings.TelemetrySettings.Enable
member.summary: Whether telemetry is enabled. Default true. When false, no meters or activity sources are subscribed and no exporter is started.

member.name: P:SharpAI.Server.Classes.Settings.TelemetrySettings.ServiceName
member.summary: Logical service name attached to all telemetry. Default "sharpai". May not be null or empty.

member.name: P:SharpAI.Server.Classes.Settings.TelemetrySettings.OtlpEndpoint
member.summary: OTLP collector endpoint. Default "http://localhost:4317". May not be null or empty.

member.name: P:SharpAI.Server.Classes.Settings.TelemetrySettings.OtlpProtocol
member.summary: OTLP protocol: "grpc" (default) or "httpprotobuf". Any other value falls back to "grpc".

member.name: P:SharpAI.Server.Classes.Settings.TelemetrySettings.PrometheusEnable
member.summary: Whether to serve an in-process Prometheus scrape endpoint (separate HttpListener). Default false; in the bundled Docker stack, metrics reach Prometheus through the OTLP collector instead.

member.name: P:SharpAI.Server.Classes.Settings.TelemetrySettings.PrometheusHostname
member.summary: Hostname for the in-process Prometheus endpoint. Default "localhost".

member.name: P:SharpAI.Server.Classes.Settings.TelemetrySettings.PrometheusPort
member.summary: Port for the in-process Prometheus endpoint. Default 9464. Clamped to the range 0-65535.

member.name: P:SharpAI.Server.Classes.Settings.TelemetrySettings.PrometheusPath
member.summary: Path for the in-process Prometheus endpoint. Default "/metrics".

member.name: P:SharpAI.Server.Classes.Settings.TelemetrySettings.EnableMetrics
member.summary: Whether metrics are exported. Default true.

member.name: P:SharpAI.Server.Classes.Settings.TelemetrySettings.EnableTraces
member.summary: Whether traces are exported. Default true.

member.name: P:SharpAI.Server.Classes.Settings.TelemetrySettings.EnableLogs
member.summary: Whether logs are exported over OTLP. Default false; the bundled stack ships logs to Loki by tailing the server's log files, so OTLP log export is off unless explicitly enabled.

member.name: M:SharpAI.Server.Program.Authorize(WatsonWebserver.Core.ApiRequest,System.String,SharpAI.Security.OperationTypeEnum,System.String)
member.summary: Enforce RBAC for a route. When authentication is disabled the request runs as the implicit system principal (IsAdmin) and this is a no-op — preserving Ollama-parity open access. When enabled, administrators bypass; every other principal is evaluated against its effective permissions, and a denial is audited and surfaced as HTTP 403.

member.name: M:SharpAI.Server.Program.ResolveManagementTenant(WatsonWebserver.Core.ApiRequest,System.String)
member.summary: Enforce tenant isolation for a management route and return the effective tenant. The implicit system principal (auth disabled) and global administrators may target any tenant; every other principal is constrained to its own tenant.
